waf-regional.ListResourcesForWebACL.doc: This is AWS WAF Classic Regional documentation. For more information, see AWS WAF Classic in the developer guide. For the latest version of AWS WAF , use the AWS WAFV2 API and see the AWS WAF Developer Guide . With the latest version, AWS WAF has a single set of endpoints for regional and global use. Returns an array of resources associated with the specified web ACL.

ResourceArns.doc: An array of ARNs (Amazon Resource Names) of the resources associated with the specified web ACL. An array with zero elements is returned if there are no resources associated with the web ACL.
